neighbours.label: Forms of 'talk' where 'about' is expected next: speaking of a topic, as opposed to other verbs in the same frame
fire: Climate is the topic that everybody keeps talking about these days.
It was the most talked about wedding in the village for years.
Parents rarely talk about money in front of their children.
He is not the person I was talking about earlier, I think.
We talked about the trip for hours and never booked a thing.
That is not something we really talk about at work.
Everyone at school was talking about the new teacher last week.
Few people have talked about this side of the debate so far.
quiet: Climate is the topic that everybody keeps reading up on these days.
It was the most photographed wedding in the village for years.
Parents rarely count money in front of their children.
He is not the person I saw earlier at the bus stop, I think.
We drove around for hours and never booked a thing.
That is not something we really do at work.
Everyone at school was playing with the new teacher's dog last week.
Few people have walked along this side of the canal so far.

notes: ' talked with' and ' talk to' still reached 0.16-0.25 in probes, and ' writing' and ' on' before 'about' fire too, so talk is the core but not the whole pole.
